Life at the Rabbit Tree

Every evening something happens. Most of it is free.

The Rabbit Tree is more than a bed in a tree. Every evening, our staff and volunteers get everyone together: we meet at the reception, go and watch the sunset, then come back for dinner and games. You don't need to book anything, just follow the group, or the hostel's WhatsApp group where every plan is posted.

  1. 4pmSunset boat days: meet at the hostel
  2. 5pmMeet at the reception, off to the beach
  3. 7pmBack at the hostel: dinner and games
  4. LateMovie, poker, or the ball pit…

Out at sunset

Our favourite evening

Sunset boat

250Kper person
  • Meet 4pm at the hostel
  • Snorkelling
  • Plankton swim
  • Dinner included

We meet at the hostel at 4pm, take a crew picture with bunny ears and walk together to the harbour. The boat takes us out for a snorkel before sunset (masks provided), the sun goes down behind Bali, and after dark we jump in again to swim with the glowing plankton. Back at the hostel, a plate of nasi goreng is waiting for everyone. Drinks are available on board.

Every evening

Sunset on the beach

Free
  • Meet 5pm at reception
  • Blankets & music
  • Cold drinks

Every evening we meet at the reception around 5pm and walk to the beach with blankets, music and a cooler of cold drinks. Find a spot in the sand, swim, and watch the sun go down with the whole hostel. We always leave the beach as clean as we found it.

Before the sunset

Beach volleyball

Free
  • 5pm
  • All levels
  • On the beach

A friendly game on the beach court, until nobody can see the ball any more or everyone stops to watch the sunset. Nobody takes it seriously: the losing team crawls between the legs of the winners.

Back at the hostel

Around the big table

Family dinner

70Kper person
  • Buffet
  • Vegetarian
  • Indonesian home cooking

A buffet of Indonesian home cooking laid out on the bar: corn fritters, yellow tofu curry, gado-gado, shredded carrots with fried tempeh. Everyone sits together at the big table: the best way to meet the whole hostel.

After the sunset

Games night

Free
  • 7pm
  • Everybody plays
  • Silly rules

Back from the beach, the games start while people order their food: Happy Salmon, charades, a quiz that gets everyone moving, sardines (hide-and-seek the other way round), the Black Ball treasure hunt hidden all over the hostel… Nobody stays on the bean bags for long.

Dress up

Gala night: gender bender

Free
  • Fancy dress
  • Limbo
  • Giant Twister

Everybody digs the fanciest outfit out of the bottom of their backpack, with a twist: the boys dress as girls and the girls as boys. Then limbo, Bang! and giant Twister, with the music turned up.

Slow night

Movie & poker night

Free
  • Cinema corner
  • Movie voted by guests
  • Poker table

The cinema corner fills up with cushions and bean bags, and the film is chosen by a poll in the hostel's WhatsApp group. Order from the bar and your food is served while the movie plays. Card players set up a poker table next door.

Drinking water, Lombok coffee and black tea are free for everyone, all day, in the common area.

From our bar & kitchen

Straight from our till, so the prices are always the right ones. Order at the bar, or put it on your room.
